positive_face_definition: The physical positive/non-reverse tabletop face has STL +Z towards the camera. For the confirmed tabletop reverse, STL +Z (= documented workpiece +Z) points into the table and STL -Z faces the camera.
grasp_point_definition: Fixed CAD landmark on the workpiece +X raised tab, shifted 10 mm along workpiece2_top_view -Y. The normal path uses this object-coordinate point directly after ICP.
reverse_pose_selection: FPFH/RANSAC global initialization plus four semantic half-turns and full-6DoF point-to-point ICP. Only candidates with STL +Z pointing into the table are accepted.
reverse_pose_selection_description: This replaces the former yaw-index initialization. The global stage evaluates reverse-compatible 6DoF CAD poses rather than constraining motion to tabletop yaw.
